sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to STL-Torino-27, which is covered by the Stellantis CSR. Moving billet homogenisation to a toll processor (Termica Nord S.r.l.) adds a sub-supplier and a new manufacturing location. That needs a documented risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before any shipment. No approval or notification in force covers it.

sources.quote: An approval covers the named manufacturing location only.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.

findings.why: AP-0311 approves Alluminio B only at Settimo Torinese. Homogenisation at Termica Nord S.r.l. is a different location, and the ASL has no approval for it for BR-220, TO1 and STL. The 'same 6082-T6 spec' statement does not extend the approval.
